contentPattern.structure: row of platform links (facebook / twitter / instagram) rendered as square icon buttons

suitableFor: author byline and share rows on magazine-article pages
any row of social media icon links

notes: Bespoke capstone custom block. Renders authored social links as dark square icon buttons with inline SVGs for Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram. Platform is detected from the link href/text. Paired with the author block per contributor on the About Us page.
